name: latex-deepseek
description: Local LaTeX and Markdown editor for DeepSeek Harness, independently installed from LaTeX Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Edit LaTeX and Markdown with DeepSeek Harness.
interface.longDescription: A local editor with automatic TeX compilation, bundled PDF.js, Markdown previews and per-change Keep / Undo. Send, project chat and history summaries use the installed signed-in DeepSeek Harness CLI. Optional main-chat forwarding uses a separately configured bridge. Requires Python 3.10+ and an existing TeX installation for PDF compilation. Installed independently from the native LaTeX Codex plugin.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use LaTeX DeepSeek to open my LaTeX file with DeepSeek Harness.
